warranty.summary: If stain we applied peels or flakes off a deck floor within 2 years, or off railings, fences or siding within 3 years, we come back and fix that area for free — labor and materials.
covers: Peeling, flaking or lifting of the finish we applied
Labor and materials to prep and recoat the failed area
Railings, posts, fences and log walls for the longer vertical term
excludes: Normal fading and wear in high-traffic spots (that is what maintenance coats are for)
Damage from furniture, grills, pets, planters, ice melt or pressure washing by others
Wood that is rotten, split or soaked by a leak or bad drainage
Solid stain on deck floors gets a 1-year term, because film finishes are known to wear faster on walking surfaces
conditions: Keep the deck swept and clear of leaf piles
Call us within 30 days of noticing a problem
Transferable once to a new owner if you sell the home

process.title: Send photos
process.text: Snap 3–5 pictures and send them in. One wide shot of the whole deck helps most. You get a price range the same day, most of the time.

process.title: Pick a color
process.text: Try colors on a photo of your own deck. We bring real samples to the job so you see it on your wood before we start.

process.title: We wash & prep
process.text: Day one: low-pressure wash, strip or brighten as needed, fix popped nails. Then the wood has to dry.

process.title: We stain & seal
process.text: Day two: we brush and back-brush every board. Most decks take two days, start to finish.
